_comment: Single source of truth for the demo hub. `node scripts/gen-demo-qr.js --eas` regenerates the QR PNGs. PRIMARY target = EAS Update opened in Expo Go (exp://u.expo.dev/<easProjectId>?channel-name=<updateChannel>); publish with scripts/publish-demo-updates.sh. APK (GitHub Releases) is the Android no-Expo-Go fallback.

credentials.note: Every seeded account uses this password. Full list: backend/src/agent_workflow/ingestion/demo_credentials.csv (regenerate with seed_postgres_dataset.py).

apps.name: AyuLink
apps.blurb: Medical ID QR, the Ayu health-profile assistant, AI symptom triage, find & book a doctor, prescriptions, care timeline, dose reminders.
try: Register with a fresh 12-digit NIC, or sign in as NIC 200012345678.
Open the Ayu bubble — it plans questions from what your profile is missing.
Diagnosis tab: describe symptoms in Sinhala or English, then book the doctor it finds.

apps.name: AyuLink Doctor
apps.blurb: Scan a patient's Medical ID, read the full clinical history, issue a structured digital prescription with a follow-up plan.
try: Sign in as any seeded doctor (NIC from the CSV, password password123).
Scan & Prescribe: type AYU-200012345678, tap Clinical History.
Pick that patient's booked appointment, then issue a prescription.

apps.name: AyuLink Pharmacy
apps.blurb: Scan the Medical ID or a single-prescription QR, see allergies + current medicines only, dispense item by item with a 15-minute undo.
try: Sign in as any seeded pharmacy (NIC or licence no. from the CSV).
Scan AYU-200012345678 to see that patient's active prescriptions.
Dispense an item, then use the 15-minute undo.

apps.name: AyuLink Channeling Center
apps.blurb: Every appointment booked at this centre — confirm, reschedule, cancel, mark complete — independent of which app booked it.
try: Sign in as any seeded channeling centre (NIC from the CSV).
Open today's appointments and confirm one the patient just booked.
